## Fixed

- **The feed no longer stops opening.** Every time you came back to the home screen, TheLauncher Feed opened another link to the Google app and kept the old ones. After a while the Google app stopped answering and only a force stop of the Google app brought the feed back. Each link now replaces the one before it.
- **The feed comes back by itself when the Google app updates.** An update ends the link for good; TheLauncher and TheLauncher Feed now notice and connect again, even when the update lands while you're in another app.
- **If the feed still isn't there when you return to the home screen, TheLauncher reconnects on its own** (at most once every 30 seconds).

## Update TheLauncher Feed

This fix needs the new TheLauncher Feed (1.2). After updating, the feed settings show **Update TheLauncher Feed**; tap it and confirm. The feed stays off until the companion is updated.
